Instruments.spectrum_analyzer_signal_hound.Initiate Class¶

class Instruments.spectrum_analyzer_signal_hound.Initiate(instrument, data_handler)[source]¶

Bases: object

The Initiate commands control when measurements are performed in the application.

__init__(instrument, data_handler)[source]¶
immediate()[source]¶

IMMediate - Trigger a measurement.

Triggers a measurement. Has no effect if CONTinuous is enabled.

Parameter: None Return: None

is_continuous_enabled()[source]¶

CONTinuous? - Query if continuous measurement is enabled.

Returns True if continuous measurement is enabled, False otherwise.

Parameter: None Return: bool: True if continuous measurement is enabled, False otherwise.

set_continuous(state)[source]¶

CONTinuous - Enable/Disable continuous measurement operation.

This state is global and will affect all measurements. When enabled, measurements are automatically triggered after the previous measurement is finished. When disabled, measurements are triggered only on the IMMediate command.

Parameter: state (int or str): 1/0 or ‘ON’/’OFF’ to enable/disable continuous measurement. Return: None
